recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-29405 unless a future work group decision changes the datatype again.
issue_request: FHIR-29405 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request to change ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.description from string to markdown for R5, aligning this IG resource-description slot with markdown description elements used by conformance and terminology resources.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as fixed in commit f17c0b884b75a77399e338f85816accad8a8febd. Git history shows that merge commit for HL7/fhir#1820 and implementation commit baab437e66f3a3153e4dc562725f87dac2859e7a, which changed the element type in source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml from string to markdown.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists implementationguide=ImplementationGuide in [resources], so the inspected StructureDefinition source is in the current build scope. The current source has ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.description typed as markdown, and the checked-in implementationguide.svg diagram also shows markdown for that element. FHIR-I minutes on 2020-11-02 record a 12-0-0 Persuasive motion for FHIR-29405. The originating Zulip discussion explains the tooling problem: SUSHI was already sourcing markdown conformance-resource descriptions into this IG element, and Eric Haas said he would file the Jira to make the IG element markdown. No later conflicting community context was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source file was edited because the active authoritative source already implements the approved datatype change.
